faq.q: I don't have time to set up new software.
faq.a: We set you up. We can also import your spreadsheets for you, quoted to your data.
Give them their own access. They see the books, not your attendance or Skill Pathways.

faq.q: I teach at more than one school.
faq.a: Each program keeps its own roster and records, and you switch between them.
We quote each program to fit its size and the parts it uses.

h1: Booster books, built from what families pay.
title: For booster clubs
sub: Balances, payments, ledgers and budgets, so the treasurer's report is ready before the meeting.
cta: Bring your treasurer to the demo.

faq.q: What happens when the board turns over?
faq.a: The records stay with the program, not in someone's laptop. New officers sign in and pick up where the last ones left off.
Each officer gets access to the areas they run, and nothing else.

faq.q: Does Program Partner hold our money?
faq.a: Never. It goes straight to your account, with no Program Partner fee.

faq.q: Some families pay us on Venmo, Cash App or Zelle.
faq.a: They upload the receipt in their portal, and your treasurer approves it onto the right balance.
